title: Microcystin-LR removal by powdered activated carbon: the influence of natural organic matter in non-bloom and bloom water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1271-1284
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00999A, Paper
Katarzyna Jaszczyszyn, Sigrid Peldszus, Peter M. Huck
This bench-scale study examined the impact of natural organic matter fractions on microcystin-LR adsorption to powdered activated carbons prior to and during a cyanobacterial bloom in a small lake using liquid chromatography-organic carbon detection.
